newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: Spanish government bonds ended sharply higher on Wednesday but off peaks amid growing confidence Spain would meet the convergence criteria and join in the launch of the European single currency.
Rumours about the worsening health of Russian president Boris Yeltsin, later denied, knocked the market off its peaks but it ended the day sharply higher nonetheless.
"There are few reasons to explain in a logical fashion what's happening in the bond market," one dealer said.
There were hopes for further interest rate cuts in Spain after the Bank of Spain raised worries about consumer demand.
